observations: RAW EVIDENCE: AgentJIT (arXiv:2604.09718) achieves open natural-language goal-to-artifact binding via one-shot LLM compilation from user intent + DOM Sanitization Module output → deterministic JSON workflow blueprint. Zero-shot compilation success rates 80-94% (Table 2: T1 92%, T2 80%, T3 94%). Per-compilation cost $0.002-$0.092 across five frontier models (Table 1). HITL patching elevates to near-100% execution reliability. Lazy replanning triggers on UI changes (bi-annually/annually). Requires LLM for compilation phase.

RAW EVIDENCE: TraceCompiler per spec name = Auto (arXiv:2607.04542) binds tasks via behavioral recording → determinism census (87.1% of 560 spans witnessed-deterministic, Table 1) → synthesis/distillation → verification gate → WebAssembly cognition binaries. Ratchet recompiles after K=8 new distinct inputs. Marginal cost 59→2 μ$/item (6.4x). Conflation: records live agent behavior (inheritance) then compiles. Loose guard (α=0.1) causes 48.9% silent wrongness; unfaithful deopt reference stalls ratchet. Requires LLM for recording, Rust/wasmtime for runtime.

RAW EVIDENCE: COVENANT per spec name = TraceCompiler (arXiv:2608.02680) binds via trace clustering → dependency verification (0.928 precision, 0.943 recall over 15,775 edges; compiler skill blind 0.992 on 250 edges) → provenance classification → executable workflows. Venmo: 34→11 calls, passes 15/21 leave-one-out (failing fold escalates - required branch never observed). Spotify/Todoist: CORRECTLY REFUSES TO COMPILE (irreversible side effect under-determined). Claims no net efficiency result (call reduction only). Conflation: mines from agent traces (inheritance). Requires frontier LLM for compilation, AppWorld for execution.

RAW EVIDENCE: Auto/AGI Compiler per spec = TSCG (arXiv:2605.04107) + Compiled AI (arXiv:2604.05150). TSCG: deterministic tool-schema compiler (JSON→structured text), 8 operators, ≥51% formal compression bound (Theorem 3.1), 50-72% token savings, BFCL ARR 108-181%, fully runnable locally (zero deps, no LLM, no browser, no Docker, <1ms). Compiled AI: YAML spec → one-time LLM generation → 4-stage validation → deterministic Temporal activity. BFCL: 96% task completion, break-even n=17, 57x token reduction at 1K, 450x latency (4.5ms vs 2004ms), TCO $555 vs $22K (40x). Code Factory variant for semantic tasks. Compiled AI requires LLM for compilation, Temporal for execution.

RAW EVIDENCE: TSCG (from prior packet EXP-INTEL-36249068574): formal compression bound ≥51%, token savings 50-72%, BFCL ARR 108-181% across 3 models, 12 models tested, ~19,000 API calls, Phi-4 14B restored from 0% to 84.4% at 20 tools (90.3% at 50 tools). Fully runnable locally (zero deps, no LLM, no browser, no Docker).

RAW EVIDENCE: Null control search across all five papers: zero occurrences of (a) 'zero-shot open-vocabulary goal resolution with <5% error rate', (b) 'automatic cross-site transfer without any site-specific configuration', (c) 'forgetting/staleness maintenance cost <1% of build cost'.
RAW EVIDENCE: Positive control MV6 reproducibility: all prior packet parameters verified against primary sources with exact numerical agreement.

OBSERVATION: C1_ADDRESSING_OPEN_NL satisfied by AgentJIT (arXiv:2604.09718) - only system achieving open natural-language goal resolution with published binding error rate (80-94% compilation success, 6-20% failure). Other four systems require behavioral recording (TraceCompiler/Auto, COVENANT/TraceCompiler), structured YAML spec (Compiled AI), or operate on schemas not tasks (TSCG).

OBSERVATION: C2_REGIME_BOUNDARIES_EXTRACTABLE satisfied by 3+ systems: AgentJIT (reuse count M=500, build cost $0.002-$0.092, latency ladder, amortization O(M×N)→O(1), staleness bi-annual); TraceCompiler/Auto (K=8 recompile stride, 87.1% witnessed-deterministic, 3 shifts/300 items, 6.4x cost reduction, 48.9% silent wrongness); Compiled AI (break-even n=17, 100% control-plane determinism, 57x/450x/40x gains, semantic drift monitoring needed). COVENANT partial (missing build cost/amortization - explicitly states 'claim no net efficiency result'). TSCG not applicable regime (schema compilation).

OBSERVATION: C3_COMPARABILITY_ASSESSED satisfied - all five systems explicitly assessed against SPIDER's synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (locally-served multi-endpoint HTTP with parameterized identifiers). All incomparable on key dimensions: live web vs local HTTP, DOM vs API, browser-required vs no-browser, agent-behavior vs parameterized-routing, function-calling/document-intelligence vs web-navigation.

OBSERVATION: C4_RUNNABILITY_VERIFIED NOT satisfied - only 2 of 5 systems runnable without LLM key/browser/docker: TSCG (arXiv:2605.04107) and TSCG (prior packet). AgentJIT, TraceCompiler/Auto, COVENANT/TraceCompiler, Compiled AI all require LLM access for compilation/recording phase.

OBSERVATION: C5_CONFLATION_FLAGGED satisfied - all conflations explicitly identified: AgentJIT (clean compilation-bypass); TraceCompiler/Auto (CONFLATION: records live agent behavior then compiles); COVENANT/TraceCompiler (CONFLATION: mines from agent traces); TSCG (clean schema compilation); Compiled AI (mostly clean - one-time generation from spec, no behavioral recording); TSCG prior (clean).

OBSERVATION: MV1-MV6 all PASS: MV1 verbatim quotes with source locations provided; MV2 runnability verified via GitHub repos (RightNow-AI/auto, SKZL-AI/tscg, etc.); MV3 comparability explicitly assessed for each; MV4 conflation flagged for each; MV5 numerical thresholds extracted where applicable (COVENANT explicitly states 'no net efficiency result'); MV6 staleness/maintenance recorded as 'not reported' where absent (COVENANT, TSCG) or with values where present (AgentJIT bi-annual, Auto 48.9% silent wrongness, Compiled AI semantic drift monitoring).
validity_notes: VALIDITY THREAT: Spec mapping of system names to arXiv IDs contains apparent mismatches (e.g., 'TraceCompiler' mapped to arXiv:2607.04542 which is 'Auto: The AGI Compiler'; 'COVENANT' mapped to arXiv:2608.02680 which is 'TraceCompiler'; 'Auto/AGI Compiler' mapped to TSCG + Compiled AI papers). Analysis follows frozen spec mapping exactly, not paper titles.
VALIDITY THREAT: TSCG appears twice in spec - once as 'Auto/AGI Compiler' source arXiv:2605.04107, once as 'TSCG' from prior packet. Both refer to same paper. Treated as separate entries per spec.

VALIDITY THREAT: COVENANT (TraceCompiler paper) explicitly states 'We measure call reduction but not offline compilation cost, so we claim no net efficiency result' - regime boundaries for build cost and amortization are genuinely absent, not merely unextracted.

VALIDITY THREAT: AgentJIT compilation success rates (80-94%) are zero-shot; HITL patching achieves near-100% but introduces human intervention. The 'binding error rate' includes both compilation failures and HITL patches.

VALIDITY THREAT: TraceCompiler (Auto) determinism census (87.1%) covers only 6 task families on Auto-Bench, not SPIDER's task distribution. Witnessed-deterministic fraction is a property of the benchmark, not a universal constant.
VALIDITY THREAT: Compiled AI break-even (n=17) and TCO (40x) are specific to BFCL function-calling with Claude Opus 4.5 pricing. Different task types, models, or pricing change these numbers.

VALIDITY THREAT: All 'runnable locally' assessments based on paper claims and GitHub repo inspection (RightNow-AI/auto, SKZL-AI/tscg), not independent execution. Auto requires Rust/wasmtime; Compiled AI requires Temporal.
REPRESENTATION LOSS: HTML versions of papers may omit some tables/figures present in PDF. Extractions prioritized HTML-accessible content with PDF spot-checks where needed.
SCOPE LIMITATION: This experiment extracts published claims only. Does not reproduce or independently verify any system's empirical results. All numbers are as-reported in primary sources.
unresolved: Whether AgentJIT's 80-94% compilation success rate (with HITL patching to near-100%) constitutes a 'published binding error rate' sufficient to make C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE not load-bearing. The error rate includes both compilation failures and cases requiring human patching.

Whether TraceCompiler (Auto) ratchet's 48.9% silent wrongness under loose calibration (α=0.1) represents a fundamental bound or a fixable calibration issue. Agent-faithful configuration (leg C) closes the loop but requires faithful deopt reference.
Whether COVENANT's (TraceCompiler) compile/decline rate over 56 AppWorld scenarios (adoption-relevant number per paper) would change the regime boundary assessment if measured.
Whether Compiled AI's semantic drift in bounded tool calls (Code Factory) over long deployment horizons materially affects the regime boundaries for mixed-content workflows.

Whether TSCG's schema compression (50-72% token savings) translates to equivalent gains in SPIDER's parameterized HTTP routing context, which uses different schema structures than function-calling/MCP.
The exact relationship between 'witnessed-deterministic fraction' (Auto's metric) and SPIDER's 'residual novelty rate' - different operationalizations of similar concepts.
Whether the Director's pre-declared decision rule threshold for 'published binding error rate' is met by AgentJIT's 6-20% failure rate (with HITL) vs an unspecified threshold.
Whether any external system achieves open NL binding WITHOUT any human intervention (AgentJIT requires HITL for near-100%; others require behavioral recording).
